lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill region. The spots are organized into approximately four visible horizontal rows and several vertical columns across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots, most notably in the mid-lateral section, creating a visible grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a bright upper edge and a cast shadow immediately beneath it, creating a sharp vertical gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, positioned ventrally and centrally in the frame, displays a dense cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more regularly spaced spots on the main lateral flank.
